headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 16, 2026**
article:
The White Sox edged the Tigers in a thrilling 4-3 victory, with Eduardo Valencia leading the offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs. In other action, the Cardinals took down the Cubs 8-4 behind a dominant performance from Michael McGreevy, while the Yankees fell to the Blue Jays in Toronto.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Sebastián Rivero, who has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. has been placed on the 7-day injured list with a concussion, and Abner Uribe has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 11 with a right forearm flexor strain.

The Brewers bolstered their infield with the acquisition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas in a trade with the Athletics for cash.

top_news.title: **White Sox Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with Jordan Hicks earning the win after 1.2 scoreless innings. Eduardo Valencia led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: Cardinals Take Down Cubs 8-4
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs, led by a dominant performance from Michael McGreevy. McGreevy pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 6 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees suffered a 1-4 loss to the Toronto Blue Jays, with Charles McAdoo leading the Yankees' offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Fall to Giants in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants dominated the Colorado Rockies 7-1, securing a decisive victory. Drew Gilbert led the Rockies' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Rivero Placed on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels catcher Sebastián Rivero has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture. The injury occurred on August 15, 2026.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Ornelas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have strengthened their roster with the addition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas, acquired in a trade with the Athletics for cash.
